notes: Phase 3 (03-FEATURE-SPECS.md §Struggles). Ownership (a) private-by-default, with the checklist and the free-form story each having their OWN independent share/unshare toggle -- sharing one doesn't share the other. Trust-gate consent + 'you're not broken' reassurance shown above the checklist always, not just on first view, per spec. Never uses the word 'issues' anywhere in its own copy -- checked against every string before writing it. Cluster view is opt-in, off by default, explicitly framed as a different lens, not a diagnosis. Daily check-in reuses FeelingEvent's own shape/storage (S.feelingHistory / eravors_feeling_history) rather than a parallel schema, entered through a different door as the spec puts it; capped at once per day whether answered or dismissed with 'don't want to talk about it' (both count as handled for today). The four sync gates (struggles:checklist_shared/_unshared, struggles:story_shared/_unshared) live in shared/eravos-kernel.js, cross-cutting, since a partner's shared checklist/story has to update regardless of which tab is open -- and were correctly placed AFTER const syncStream = new Stream() this time, having thrown a real 'Cannot access before initialization' error on that exact mistake during Meaning Archive's build just before this one. Honest gap: the 'Horrible' branch's AI-assisted expression-help is explicitly deferred per spec, not built -- sharing a check-in result is a plain, unassisted share.
